pages.text: The panel opened with $(bold)V$() is used to manage the town: place buildings, lay roads, and manage tasks and wizards. It opens in $(bold)overview mode$() by default: the camera rises above your head to survey the whole town.$(br2)The panel has two states — understand these and you have the basics:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Normal state$() (no tab active): the mouse stays in the game layer. Just move the mouse to rotate the camera, and use the $(bold)crosshair$() at the screen center to target buildings and wizards.$(li)$(bold)Sub-modes$() (the Build / Road construction states): the cursor is lifted so you can click the panel UI freely, and you rotate the camera by $(bold)holding right-click and dragging$(). The $(bold)Tasks$() tab opens a full-screen management hub that covers the sidebar and top bar.

$(li)$(bold)Normal interaction$(): move the mouse to rotate the camera; point the $(bold)crosshair$() at a building or wizard and press $(bold)right-click$() to open its panel (name the Town Hall, stock a shop, order node gathering, equip a wizard, set strategy, etc.).$(li)$(bold)Rotate the camera in a sub-mode$(): $(bold)hold right-click and drag$() — while the cursor is lifted, moving the mouse only moves the pointer, so dragging with right-click is how you turn the view.$(li)$(bold)Rotate a building's facing$(): while placing a building, $(bold)left-click$() the ghost to rotate its direction.$(li)$(bold)Quickly switch modes$(): press $(bold)1 / 2 / 3$() to jump straight to Build / Road / Tasks.
pages.title: Most-Used Actions

pages.text: $(bold)Key  Action$()$(li)$(bold)V$() — Open / close the panel$(li)$(bold)F4$() — Hide / show the panel (does not block the F3 debug screen)$(li)$(bold)1 / 2 / 3$() — Quickly switch to $(bold)Build / Road / Tasks$()$(li)$(bold)B$() — Show / hide building boundary boxes$(li)$(bold)H$() — Open the help guide$(li)$(bold)C$() — Raise the cursor$(li)$(bold)Tab$() — Fold / expand the tutorial guide (reverts to the vanilla player list once the guide is done)
pages.title: Key Bindings

pages.text: Flying works the same as creative mode: $(bold)WASD$() to pan, $(bold)Space / Shift$() to ascend/descend, $(bold)scroll wheel$() to zoom. To inspect a building up close, fly closer; flight speed is fixed and can be adjusted in the mod config under $(#8a5a2b)panel.flySpeed$(). In the normal state just move the mouse to rotate the camera; in the Build / Road sub-modes hold right-click and drag instead.
pages.title: Flying in Overview Mode

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Build$(): the building bar below lists buildable structures by category (All / Government / Storage / Service / Shops / Relax / ATM / Workshop / Node). Flow: $(bold)single-click$() to select → $(bold)double-click$() to enter placement → the ghost preview follows your mouse → $(bold)left-click$() to rotate the facing → press $(bold)Submit$() on the right panel to open the construction screen → $(bold)Submit$() to build. If the position needs fine-tuning: press $(bold)Lock$() (or $(bold)Enter$()) to pin it, drag the $(bold)3D axis gizmo$() to move it, then $(bold)Submit$(). While pinned, $(bold)Esc$() returns to aiming; $(bold)Esc$() again exits placement. First-free buildings are marked in the bar.$(li)$(bold)Roads$(): the paving toolset — see $(l:wandscape:road/road_guide)Road System Overview$(/l).$(li)$(bold)Tasks$(): the full-screen task & mage management hub — a central view of global tasks and your wizards.
pages.title: The Three Sidebar Tabs

pages.text: In the Build and Road sub-modes the cursor is already lifted so you can click the sidebar, building bar, and right panel — rotate the camera by right-drag, no C needed. When you need the cursor lifted so the pointer can move freely between the panel UI and the world, press $(bold)C$().
pages.title: Raising the Cursor (C)

pages.text: While the tutorial guide card is showing, $(bold)Tab$() folds / expands it so you can see the panel and the world. Once the guide is done, Tab reverts to its vanilla function (the player list).
pages.title: Folding / Expanding the Tutorial Guide (Tab)

pages.text: $(li)Build the $(bold)Town Hall$() to create your colony.$(li)Build a $(bold)Warehouse$() to store materials.$(li)Connect the buildings with the road tools — tourists only walk on paved roads.$(br2)See $(l:wandscape:start/getting_started_guide)Getting Started$(/l) for the full route.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:road/road_guide)Road System Overview$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
